text:
Hannah (People Ops): Quick heads-up for folks traveling to London next month for the Europe meetup: a few logistical changes and reminders to make arrivals smoother. Please skim and share with any guests youre inviting. :airplane:

Hannah (People Ops): Main points: 1) hotel room block expires 2/28 (code REDWOOD2026), 2) were changing the per diem policy for event days (see below), 3) visa/LOE letters: request from Travel Desk at least 10 business days before travel. Links: hotel block https://redwood.internal/travel/london-block, LOE form https://redwood.internal/forms/loe

Ravi (EMEA Events): To add: there will be a small speaker reception Tues evening at the hub; please register speakers via the event form so we can arrange badges and adapter kits. Speaker contact deadline 3/4.

Claire (Legal): Reminder: external guests who will be in client-sensitive meetings must sign the visitor NDA before badge pickup. Travel Desk will attach NDA link in confirmation emails.

Tom (Finance): Per diem update for event days only: meals up to £45/day covered on corporate card for attendees who RSVP to the event form. Personal meals outside event times should be expensed normally with receipts and will follow existing policy (max £30/day). Please don't mix corporate card charges and personal reimbursements on the same receipt.

Grace (People Ops): Airport pickup will be available Wed morning only (8:30 11:30). If you need pickup outside that window request it on the travel form and well quote a taxi reimbursement instead. Shuttle from Paddington runs 9:00 and 10:30.

Facilities Bot: Note: the London hub will be closed for a deep-clean Friday 3/12 18:00 through Saturday 3/13 09:00. No after-hours access during that window. If you have equipment or storage needs, coordinate with Facilities by 3/1.

Travel Desk: LOE/visa letters: submissions after 3/4 may not be processed in time. For invitation letters we need passport name, nationality, DOB, and travel dates. Use the LOE form link above.

Hannah (People Ops): Guests: external contractors and partners are welcome but must be preregistered and have a sponsor. Sponsors are responsible for giving them the visitor NDA link and confirming times. Badge pickup at the main lobby only.

Ravi (EMEA Events): Catering for the reception will be limited to building-approved vendors; catering requests need 5 business days notice. If you're planning a team dinner on Friday night, submit a facility request by 3/5.

Tom (Finance): Expense tip: if you use a personal card, tag expenses with project "EMEA-Meetup-2026" in Concur to avoid delays.

Claire (Legal): Also note: photo release for event marketing. If you dont want to be photographed, set "No Photos" on your event RSVP and the front desk will add a sticker to your badge.

Grace (People Ops): Questions or special needs (accessibility, dietary, childcare stipend) -> DM me or open the People Ops form. We'll publish a consolidated Logistics FAQ in #all-hands-ops by EOD Friday. :calendar:
